cand.title: IATA Emergency Planning and Response for Airports and GSPs with ERP Simulation
cand.excerpt: Best accessible mechanism: repeated, multi-day, airport-adjacent training with no hotel partner stated.
cand.ledgerVenue: IATA Geneva Training Center, Route de l’Aéroport 33

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two verified current relationship-routing candidates: Gina Sanjinés Navia, IATA Training Specialist for Europe, Russia & CIS, based in Madrid, is the published regional training contact; Tanja Schmidt, IATA Training Director, is confirmed by a 2025 official article and a published agenda for 19 November 2026. Neither is verified as the hotel buyer or contract signatory. Historical additional lead: Marc Chollet, Coordinator Business Travel, credited on the 2023 delegate hotel programme with a preparation date of 21 January 2022; current employment and responsibility are unverified.
findings.futureEdition: Officially published next Geneva cohort: 15–19 February 2027, English, class 6530281, five days / 40 hours. Important correction to discovery: 26–30 July 2027, class 6529252, is Montreal, not Geneva. The course also lists Singapore, 29 March–2 April 2027, class 6529938, and 4–8 October 2027, class 6529595, without a retrievable city for October. No additional Geneva or 2028 cohort was located; do not project annual Geneva dates.
findings.hotelProductFit: Assessment/inference using the supplied hotel specification: YOTEL Geneva Lake is a conditional lodging option for nonlocal trainees or instructors, not a replacement teaching venue. Its Founex/La Côte setting is outside Geneva city; the published hotel page describes roughly ten minutes by road to Geneva Airport. The hotel advertises an airport shuttle in morning/evening only, no midday service, not pre-bookable. That does not establish reliable daily course transfers or capacity for a cohort. Confirm transport against actual class hours before pitching. No retreat/resort requirement is published. Its six meeting rooms are ancillary to this opportunity; do not assume off-site teaching, banquet capacity, a 20–120-room block, or use of all 237 rooms. Attendance is unpublished, so materiality and whether demand is below the hotel’s preferred block size remain unknown.
findings.venueCommitments: Published Geneva delivery is at IATA Geneva Training Center in the IATA Executive Office, Route de l’Aéroport 33, 1215 Geneva 15 Airport, Switzerland. City label: Geneva; region: Canton of Geneva; territory: Geneva Airport corridor, not downtown Geneva and not Founex/La Côte. The center describes its location as less than a three-minute walk from the airport. This is an institutional training venue, not a competing hotel. Public venue designation is verified; a contractual venue agreement was not inspected.
findings.historicalRotation: An IATA-hosted pre-production London center schedule lists the course on 26–30 October 2026, class 2895181. That center identifies Novotel London West Hotel, 1 Shortlands, London W6 8DR, as its venue from 1 January 2025. Treat this as historical published scheduling, not proof of attendance or completion. Geneva, Singapore and Montreal in 2027 establish multi-city delivery, not an exclusive destination rotation or recurring annual Geneva commitment. No reliable 2025 edition was established.
findings.accommodationSourcing: A hotel pathway exists: the live Geneva center page says, “As a course participant you can benefit from special rates with hotels near the Geneva training center. You will receive all reservation details once registered for a course.” The February 2027 hotel names, allotments and booking obligations are not public. No edition-specific housing bureau, host hotel, room block or open hotel RFP was found. Historical 2023 delegate programme names Hilton Geneva, Movenpick Geneva and Crown Plaza Geneva, offers direct hotel booking, and states: “All rates are for individual bookings only and do not apply to groups/block bookings.” An undated IATA visitor guide names Hilton Geneva and Crowne Plaza Geneva for negotiated rates, and lists these nearby shuttle hotels: Crowne Plaza Geneva; Everness Hotel & Resort Chavannes de Bogis; Hilton Geneva Hotel & Conference Centre; Holiday Inn Express Geneva Airport; Ibis Genève Aéroport; Mövenpick Hotel & Casino Geneva; Nash Airport Hotel; NH Geneva Airport Hotel. These lists are contextual competitors, not February 2027 booking commitments; old rates and shuttle schedules are not revalidated.
findings.organizationStructure: IATA is the trade association for the world’s airlines. IATA Training owns/delivers the course, and the Geneva center is within IATA’s Executive Office. No external PCO, DMC, event agency or housing bureau was identified for this cohort. Participant employers and the party paying for their accommodation are not disclosed.
findings.competitiveLimitations: IATA already offers training participants access to nearby special hotel rates; historical negotiated relationships favor established airport hotels. This weakens an assumption of unsourced hotel demand but does not prove exclusive current contracting. Everness appears in an undated visitor guide, providing historical contextual evidence that a La Côte-area hotel can appear in IATA travel information, not proof of current participant use. No sold-out hotels, overflow demand, unmet inventory, published room nights, attendance or peak-room count were found.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Gina Sanjinés Navia through the published training-sales channel and request an introduction to the Geneva Training Center operations lead and person managing participant hotel rates. Reference class 6530281, 15–19 February 2027. Ask for the current accommodation instructions, whether bookings are individual/employer-paid or centrally arranged, named contracted hotels and exclusivity, expected nonlocal attendance, actual hotel take-up, class hours and hotel-program renewal process. Offer a conditional participant rate and a separately validated transfer solution; do not reserve speculative inventory. Use Tanja Schmidt for senior training-account sponsorship only if appropriate. Seek the current successor to historical travel coordinator Marc Chollet rather than assume he remains responsible. Final qualification and publication remain with ORS.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 15–19 February 2027 is a confirmed upcoming classroom activity within the requested horizon. Hotel sourcing remains unconfirmed: reservation instructions are disclosed after registration. Accessible commercial route is to request consideration for participant lodging/referrals if permitted, not to claim an open group block or venue bid. No evidence establishes that all lodging is centrally contracted or that participants can freely choose hotels; obtain that distinction before sales qualification.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: pursue inclusion in the Geneva training accommodation programme as a longer-term account relationship, subject to its supplier selection process. In-house training is expressly available through regional specialists, but no YOTEL-hosted course or venue RFP is announced. July 2027 Montreal is not local room demand; October cannot be counted as local demand without location confirmation. No future Geneva cycle beyond February is verified.
